args.content:
name: CI

# PR-only status check. Push-to-main gating lives entirely inside
# deploy.yml's own `test` job (sequential: test -> build -> deploy, one
# workflow run, one SHA) so this workflow can never race a broken push
# against a deploy — see docs/DEPLOYMENT.md.
on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]

jobs:
  build-test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          submodules: false

      - uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable
        with:
          components: rustfmt, clippy

      - uses: Swatinem/rust-cache@v2

      - name: fmt
        run: cargo fmt --all -- --check

      - name: clippy
        run: cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings

      - name: build
        run: cargo build --workspace --all-targets

      - name: test
        run: cargo test --workspace

  real-browser-smoke:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          submodules: false
      - uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable
      - uses: Swatinem/rust-cache@v2
      - name: Resolve installed Chrome
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          CHROME="$(command -v google-chrome || command -v chromium || command -v chromium-browser)"
          test -n "$CHROME"
          "$CHROME" --version
          echo "ZERO3_CHROME_PATH=$CHROME" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
      - name: Real Chromium semantic BrowserProvider smoke
        run: cargo test -p zero3-providers --test browser_real -- --ignored --nocapture

  real-windows-ocu-smoke:
    runs-on: windows-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          submodules: false
      - uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '22'
      - uses: Swatinem/rust-cache@v2
      - name: Install current Open Computer Use
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          npm install --global open-computer-use
          $cmd = (Get-Command open-computer-use.cmd).Source
          if (-not $cmd) { throw 'open-computer-use.cmd was not installed' }
          & $cmd --help
          "ZERO3_OCU_BIN=$cmd" | Out-File -FilePath $env:GITHUB_ENV -Encoding utf8 -Append
          "ZERO3_OCU_APP=Notepad" | Out-File -FilePath $env:GITHUB_ENV -Encoding utf8 -Append
      - name: Open real Notepad window
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          Start-Process notepad.exe
          Start-Sleep -Seconds 3
          Get-Process notepad -ErrorAction Stop | Select-Object -First 1 | Format-List Id,ProcessName,SessionId
      - name: Real Windows OCU MCP handshake and UIA smoke
        run: cargo test -p zero3-providers --test open_computer_use_real -- --ignored --nocapture

  windows-product-smoke:
    runs-on: windows-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          submodules: false
      - uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable
      - uses: Swatinem/rust-cache@v2
      - name: Build local Node and native desktop
        run: cargo build -p zero3-node -p zero3-desktop
      - name: Start real local Node and verify API
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
          $env:ZERO3_PILOT_DATA_DIR = Join-Path $env:RUNNER_TEMP 'zero3-pilot-product-smoke'
          $env:ZERO3_PILOT_NODE_PORT = '8790'
          New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $env:ZERO3_PILOT_DATA_DIR | Out-Null
          $nodePath = (Resolve-Path 'target\debug\zero3-pilot-node.exe').Path
          $node = Start-Process -FilePath $nodePath -PassThru
          "ZERO3_PRODUCT_NODE_PID=$($node.Id)" | Out-File -FilePath $env:GITHUB_ENV -Encoding utf8 -Append
          $healthy = $false
          for ($i = 0; $i -lt 40; $i++) {
            try {
              $health = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri 'http://127.0.0.1:8790/health' -TimeoutSec 1
              if ($health.status -eq 'ok') { $healthy = $true; break }
            } catch {}
            Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 250
          }
          if (-not $healthy) { throw 'zero3-pilot-node did not become healthy' }
          $status = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri 'http://127.0.0.1:8790/api/v1/status' -TimeoutSec 2
          if ($status.status -ne 'ok') { throw 'node status API did not return ok' }
          if ($status.agents.Count -lt 3) { throw 'node did not register all three subagents' }
      - name: Create a real WebView2 desktop and exit cleanly
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
          $env:ZERO3_PILOT_NODE_PORT = '8790'
          $env:ZERO3_DESKTOP_SMOKE_MS = '2000'
          $desktopPath = (Resolve-Path 'target\debug\zero3-pilot.exe').Path
          $desktop = Start-Process -FilePath $desktopPath -PassThru -Wait
          if ($desktop.ExitCode -ne 0) { throw "zero3-pilot desktop exited with $($desktop.ExitCode)" }
      - name: Stop product smoke Node
        if: always()
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          if ($env:ZERO3_PRODUCT_NODE_PID) {
            Stop-Process -Id ([int]$env:ZERO3_PRODUCT_NODE_PID) -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
          }
